meta.name: alfworld-tool-user
meta.description: Use when the agent needs to apply a tool to a target object in ALFWorld to accomplish an interaction such as cleaning, heating, cooling, or examining. This skill handles locating both the tool and target object, then executing the correct environment action (e.g., `clean`, `heat`, `cool`, `use`) to progress the task.

copy.tagline: 在ALFWorld环境中使用工具完成交互任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在ALFWorld模拟环境中用工具完成清洁、加热等操作。
copy.tagline_en: Use tools to complete interactions in ALFWorld environment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use tools to clean, heat, cool, or examine objects in ALFWorld.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以在ALFWorld虚拟环境中使用工具对目标物体执行清洁、加热、冷却等操作，自动完成寻找工具和物体并执行动作。
howto.when: 当任务需要你在ALFWorld中用工具对物体进行操作时触发，例如清洁、加热、冷却等。

say.note: Claude会拿到土豆并放入微波炉加热。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use tools on target objects in ALFWorld to perform actions like clean, heat, cool, etc., automatically locating both the tool and object and executing the action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task requires applying a tool to an object in ALFWorld, such as cleaning, heating, or cooling.

say_en.note: Claude will find the sink and clean the knife.

say_en.text: Heat the potato with the microwave.
say_en.note: Claude will take the potato and heat it in the microwave.
Claude will run the examine action on the book.
